title: File:End of Winter- How 2012 Snow Stacks Up (6841323036).jpg
art: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center from Greenbelt, MD, USA
desc: The mild winter of 2012 has many people asking, "Where's the snow?" These two snow cover maps show the difference between snow extent on March 3, 2011 (top), and March 5, 2012 (bottom). The maps were compiled from data collected by the Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS) instrument
